name: lyt
description: Safe local media downloads for people and AI agents, powered by yt-dlp.

interface.longDescription: Download audio and video, extract MP3s, inspect formats, or save clips using the local lyt CLI. Coding agents receive versioned JSON and exact saved paths. Requires Node.js 20+, yt-dlp, network access to the media host, and ffmpeg for conversion. This plugin is instruction-based; it does not provide a hosted download service.
defaultPrompt: Download this permitted video at 1080p and report the exact saved path.
Save the permitted audio from this URL as a 192K MP3.
Preview the available formats for this permitted media URL.
